observations: No visible clipping, character cutoffs, overlapping paragraphs, formula spill or broken table boundaries were found in the viewed images.
Some chapter-tail pages contain substantial whitespace because following chapters begin on a new page; no unexpected blank pages were seen.
Long Lean identifiers use line wrapping. Those examined at 150 dpi remain within the text area and are not clipped.
limits: All-page contact review checks gross layout; only the 12 listed focused pages were inspected at 150 dpi.
This is visual layout verification, not a new Lean, native-export, semantic-proof, link-target, or canonical publication receipt.
No manuscript, TeX, PDF or BUILD file was modified; only focused PNGs and this review evidence were written to the assigned temporary directory.
